The Java Programming Language

The Java programming language was conceived by Canadian computer scientist James Gosling. At Sun Microsystems in 1991, his goal was a platform-independent language with the slogan 'write once, run anywhere.' Java became a technology for web applications, enterprise software, and Android mobile development, making it one of modern computing's most influential innovations. #Canada #Innovation #Technology #Programming
